title: King of the Dwarves
start: Talk to Lava-flow miner Sven outside the Lava Flow Mine in East Keldagrim.

items.t: 6 mithril bars (can't be in the metal bank)

rewards.t: A new gravestone option (Royal dwarven gravestone)
Access to the Lava Flow Mine and the ability to gild pickaxes and obtain the golden mining suit
Ability to lift big rock (Level 90 Strength required to carry it away)

steps.t: Speak to Lava-flow miner Sven standing outside of the Lava Flow Mine in Keldagrim East. [Chat: 1 I'd like the tour. › Accept]
p: A Cloaked figure explodes, damaging the machinery.

steps.t: Free all 6 Lava-flow miners (they are all close to the entrance). If you leave the scene by exiting or teleporting, all progress made of rescuing the miners is lost.

sub.t: Mine the lighter coloured rubble surrounding them, then rescue them and they'll appear in your backpack. Only one Miner can be carried at a time.
Talk to Foreman Jaak with one in your backpack, then move on to the next one.

p: Mining the rubble to save the trapped miners
Black Guards arrive and refuse to help save the miners.

steps.t: Talk to Veldaban near the protesters outside. [Chat: Any › Any › Any]
Go to the top floor of the Keldagrim Palace in the centre of Keldagrim. A short cutscene will play.
p: Veldaban at the Consortium meeting room

steps.t: Talk to Veldaban. [Chat: 3 Why are you so angry? › 2 You should try to calm down.]
Talk to the Green Gemstone Director. [Chat: 4 I was there when the explosion happened. › 3 I rescued some of the miners.]
Talk to the Yellow Fortune Director. [Chat: 1 Why did you arrest Veldaban? › 1 Veldaban's popular. Arresting him makes you look worse.]
Talk to the Blue Opal Director. [Chat: 2 Tell me about the Lava Flow Mine. › 2 So the chaos dwarf blew up the secondary boilers?]
Talk to the Brown Engine Director. [Chat: 3 What did you want to do about the miners? › 2 It was a difficult decision. I understand.]
Dismiss any pets and talk to the consortium general secretary. [Chat: 1 I've talked to everyone I need to.]
Talk to Hreidmar outside the eastern entrance of the Keldagrim Palace.
Talk to one of the protesters. [Chat: 1 Does anyone know where Meike is?]
Head to the King's Axe Inn (Keldagrim West) and talk to Luitger. [Chat: 3 You're not joining the protests? › 3 Goodbye.]
Go to the Black Guard HQ (west of the bank) and talk to Klaas.
p: Talking to Meike, leader of the Monarchist Society

steps.t: Go to the top of the Keldagrim Watchtower (small building just south of the Palace, west Keldagrim) and talk to Meike. [Chat: 3 We could get into the records of the chamber first. › 1 I'll meet you both at the library.]
Go to the library north of the Palace in West Keldagrim.
Talk to Meike or Veldaban.
Talk to the Librarian. [Chat: 3 Could you open the display case, please?]
Talk to Meike or Veldaban.
Open the cabinet north of Meike.
Use the soft clay on Meike and then talk to the librarian about the keys. [Chat: 3 Can you tell me more about the keys?]
Talk to Meike.
Use the furnace (not forge) such as the one in the Palace south of the library, if the prompt doesn't show up go to another furnace. [Chat: 1 Yes. › 1 Yes.]
Go to the Records Chamber (Enter Entrance in the wall, west of the Black Guard HQ)
Talk to Meike or Veldaban.
Match up the keys with the correct keyholes. See the picture below for the solution.

p: The combination to unlock the door

steps.t: Open the door and watch the cutscene.
Talk to Veldaban. [Chat: 1 Can you show me the way to the Barendir caverns?]
Enter the tunnel to the east and go to the opposite end of the cavern.
Defeat Colonel Grimsson while making sure Veldaban does not die. If you leave the fight, you can restart by talking to Veldaban in the Laughing Miner pub in Keldagrim East.
Talk to Veldaban. [Chat: 3 We should get reinforcements. › 3 What about the trolls? › Any › 3 I'm going to go and talk to them, with or without you.]
Head back halfway through the cavern until you come to an entrance on the east side. Enter it and speak to Pretty Flower. [Chat: 2 I need to talk to you. › 2 How can I prove I'm worthy?]
Lift the big rock east of My Arm.
Lift the troll named Big Rock.
Talk to Pretty Flower [Chat: 1 We want you to help defend Keldagrim from chaos dwarves. › 4 I'll just be going.].

Talk to My Arm [Chat: 3 How can I get Pretty Flower to listen to me? › Any › 3 Wait, what pretty flower are you talking about? › 3 Could I have a pretty flower? › 2 I need to give it to Pretty Flower. › 2 I need to give the plant to the warlord.].
Talk to Pretty Flower. [Chat: 1 We want you to help defend Keldagrim from chaos dwarves. › 4 Take a look at this pretty flower... › 3 It's a gift from Colonel Grimsson.]
Go out through the same way you entered with Veldaban.
Get back to the east of the Keldagrim Palace by using the quick travel option on the Dwarven Boatman to the west.
Go to the protest east of Keldagrim Palace.
Talk to Veldaban, who is standing within the group of protesters.
Quest complete!
p: The Consortium announce that Veldaban is the new King.
Hreidmar is displeased, and Veldaban tries to arrest him, but he flees.
Veldaban is crowned King of the Dwarves

get_inside.text: The Lava Flow Mine is located through an opening on the east wall of Keldagrim. The easiest way to get there is by using the mine cart from the Grand Exchange to travel to East Keldagrim, and then run northeast.

Alternatively, players who have level 99 in at least one skill or are able to wear the Quest Cape can tune the skilling portal in Max Guild to the Lava Flow Mine. The portal will teleport the player inside the Lava Flow Mine.
